summary: Implemented the controller half of PRD_PORTABLE_WORKFLOW slice 2. New: workflow/guardrails.py (outcome-brief headings, decisions.md pinning, design challenge print job with pause/resume/--accept-challenge, worker questions with persisted deadline pause, `workflow resume` and `workflow answer`), contracts/workflow/challenge.schema.json, workflow/skills/workflow-grill/SKILL.md, workflow/test_guardrails.py (one test per controller scenario id: brief-headings, decisions-required, challenge-passes, challenge-pauses x2, completion-evidence, worker-question, export-seam, plus the skill). Changed: feature.schema.json 2.2.0 (challenge, prd); launch.py (2.2.0 refusals before Git, migration note for 2.0/2.1, prepare --guardrails flags, stops after a paused start); pipeline.py (prepare pinning, challenge gate in start, start_workers); automatic.py (completion 1.1.0 read_signal/read_completion, questions in wait_handoffs, shared print_command, decisions in reviewer prompts); interactive.py (worker_prompt with decisions); export_state.py (export 1.5.0: decisions, challenge+attempts, evidence, questions, challenge node); registry.py and scaffold.py (init writes 2.2.0 + decisions.md + prd placeholder); contracts/projects v1.ts/examples/runInputs.schema.json (inputs 1.4.0 per PRD 4.7) + contract test [scenario:export-seam]; server/projects.ts (export 1.5.0 pass-through, challenge node status) + test [scenario:served-inputs]; README/RUNBOOK/contract READMEs. Updated existing tests only where the contract changed (export version 1.4.0->1.5.0, init scaffold now 2.2.0 with decisions.md and 15 placeholders, 1.0.0 completion exports null evidence, inputs contract 1.3.0->1.4.0, unknown export version 1.5.0->1.6.0, 2.0.0 launch stderr is now exactly the migration note). Checks executed: python -m unittest workflow.test_portable workflow.test_guardrails -> 23 OK; workflow.test_guardrails.GrillSkill -> 1 OK; python -m unittest workflow.test_automatic workflow.test_interactive workflow.test_pipeline workflow.test_feature_launch workflow.test_export workflow.test_sessions -> 156 run, 1 failure (test_pipeline:266 expected export 1.4.0), fixed to 1.5.0; python -m unittest workflow.test_lanes + that pipeline test -> 22 run, 1 failure (LegacyFeatureAndRun expected empty stderr; now asserts exactly the migration note); rerun LegacyFeatureAndRun + pipeline test -> 4 OK; npm run test:contracts -> 22/22 pass; npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts -> 38/38 pass; npx tsx --test server/app.test.ts -> 3/3 pass; npm run build -> OK; npm run contracts:export regenerated runInputs.schema.json. The worktree has no node_modules: for the npm/tsx checks I symlinked /home/agentops/dev/md-manager/node_modules temporarily and removed it (and dist/) afterwards. NOT run: the full workflow suite (python -m workflow.run_tests), npm run test:unit, workflow.test_checks, workflow.test_verification, workflow.test_run_tests; nothing was run against real Claude or real Herdr.
open_assumptions: Completion 1.1.0 and every guardrail plan key apply only to runs prepared from a 2.2.0 feature (prepare --guardrails); 2.0.0/2.1.0 runs launched after slice 2 keep completion 1.0.0, so they see no guardrail refusal.
The migration note goes to stderr and the dry-run JSON key `guardrails`, not into `notes`, so existing launch output and commands stay unchanged.

The challenge runs inside `start`/`resume` outside LangGraph; the `challenge` node exists in the exported definition and registry graph only. The server derives its status from inputs.challenge (paused -> paused, passed/accepted -> succeeded), and EVENT_STATUS gains `paused`.
`resume` needs no --live (the PRD's command form); after a pass or accept it launches the workers and supervises automatic runs; --herdr attaches panes.
Feature-file edits made for `resume` leave the source checkout dirty and integration refuses a dirty source; the RUNBOOK tells the operator to stash them before integration. Nothing automates this.
The PRD is copied into <run>/challenge-inputs/ (so a PDF works) and passed with --add-dir; plan.json keeps its path and sha256. decisions.md text and task paths are pinned in plan.json.

The challenge job deadline is the run's review_timeout_seconds (1800 s for manual runs). A disabled record has attempt 0, session null, no concerns and null alternative/experiment; `attempts` equals the latest record's attempt.

Served worker-written texts (decisions, questions, answers, challenge texts, untested, verify_yourself) are path-redacted like other served text. falsifying_check is served verbatim only when it equals one of the lane's check ids or commands.
Herdr delivery uses `herdr pane send-text <pane> <text>` then `herdr pane send-keys <pane> Enter`; the key name `Enter` was not verified against real Herdr.
A worker's session going back to `working` while a question waits counts as an answer typed in the pane: it is recorded as '(answered by typing in the worker's pane)' and the deadline restarts.

A fourth question raises, which blocks the run and stops the workers like status blocked; its completion file stays in place as evidence. A question completion needs a non-empty summary like any other.
feature.json challenge/prd on a version before 2.2.0 is refused; a `prd` must be relative with no `..` (schema) and exist in the target.
